title: Make the committed-input reader's Git test fixtures ignore the machine's system Git config, so they pass on Windows
outcome: Make the committed-input reader's Git test fixtures ignore the machine's system Git config, so they pass on Windows
acceptance: committed_input::tests::live_commit_distinguishes_dirty_reverted_and_equal_tree_commits and the registered_verification git_input currency tests pass on Windows on a machine whose system Git config sets core.autocrlf=true, with the reader's runtime predicate unchanged
The test fixtures' Git calls use the same isolated configuration as the reader (no system or global config), so the result doesn't depend on the host's Git settings
